description: Update a ticket: change its status (open, in_progress, done, wontfix) and/or edit title, description, priority or due date. Closing = status done (resolved) or wontfix (will not be handled); restoreItemStatus: true on a close also sets the item back to "available" (typical after a repair). The due date is `dueDate`, a calendar day ("2026-08-11"); the legacy `dueAt` epoch still works; exactly one of the two, and null on either clears the date. Status and due-date changes appear in the ticket's timeline under the connected user's name. Only the reporter, the assignee (or a member of the assigned team) or a ticket manager (responsibleForTickets) can update it; viewers never can. Ticket ids come from list_tickets. Returns the updated ticket in the list_tickets row shape (`createdAt`, `reporterName`, `webUrl` and the ISO date twins included). Idempotent.

description.description: New description, or null to clear

dueAt.description: Due date as epoch milliseconds at UTC midnight of the day, or null to clear (legacy form of `dueDate`; exactly one of the two)

dueDate.description: Due date as a calendar day, "YYYY-MM-DD" (e.g. "2026-08-11"), or null to clear. A full timestamp is accepted only WITH an explicit offset ("2026-08-11T00:00:00+02:00"), and the server takes the calendar day as seen in that offset; it does no timezone conversion of its own, so an offset-less timestamp is refused. Passing both dueAt and dueDate is an error

priority.description: New priority, or null to clear

restoreItemStatus.description: When closing: also set the item back to "available" (typical after a repair)

status.description: New status — done = resolved, wontfix = closed without handling

name: update_ticket

closedAtIso.description: The same moment as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp

createdAt.description: When the ticket was reported, epoch milliseconds — the "since when is it broken?" answer, and what "newest first" sorts on

createdAtIso.description: The same moment as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp — read THIS one; the server does no timezone conversion

dueAtIso.description: The due date as a plain calendar day, "YYYY-MM-DD". A DAY, not a moment: the server does no timezone conversion

itemName.description: The item the ticket is about

reporterName.description: Who reported it. Absent when nobody did — a maintenance plan minted the ticket, or it came from a logged-out QR report

status.description: Ticket status: open | in_progress | done | wontfix

webUrl.description: Link to this ticket in the web app, for a person to open; `id` is the handle for tool calls. Absent when the deployment has no public address

title: Update ticket
